title: Moving together without chasing abundance
meaning: Active leisure keeps its pleasure when the wish for variety allows enthusiasm and quiet to take their natural turns.
text: Joy can live in moving towards a place you have chosen. The Chariot in the physical position of Svadhisthana helps you agree on a route and follow it together, keeping a direction. The Empress in energy, however, leans towards filling the outing with further impressions: another lovely courtyard, another treat, another stop. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions makes the response changeable. Excitement may give way to quiet although the walk remains enjoyable. Its living rhythm need not match the number of possibilities you hope to use in one outing.

Imagine a seaside promenade walk towards a distant lighthouse. On the way are stalls, musicians and unusual steps down to the water. **Shared pleasure needs your rhythm rather than an endless addition of impressions.** You can choose one stop and then walk quietly beside each other. A calmer stretch does not diminish the discovery’s value: it allows time to feel it, exchange impressions and hear what each wants now.

The chase begins if quiet seems evidence that the route has failed. You accelerate, suggest more stops and quietly hurry each other to enjoy yourselves. Mood depends increasingly on another discovery while direction is lost. Releasing some pleasant options can preserve the evening’s wholeness. It leaves you free to follow your path without sustaining equally high excitement along every part.
